reason: Verification failed with critical issues (O(N^2) and directed rewiring; divergence from specified entities/parameters; missing interactions and metrics). One iteration remains and targeted fixes can substantially improve correctness, performance, and spec compliance to reach acceptance.

specific_areas: Fix small-world rewiring: use adjacency sets, bounded rejection sampling, and maintain undirected edges to achieve O(Nk) and symmetric influence.

Align parameters with spec and add aliases: mask_price_*, restock_rate_per_day, retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita, price_elasticity_of_demand; ensure they drive supply, purchasing, and decision logic.
Implement location-based access control tied to policy/enforcement: toggle mask_requirement at workplaces/public places; deny entry or penalize non-wearers and track denied_access metrics.
Add attitude term in mask-wearing utility with tunable attitude_weight to connect beliefs to behavior.
Expand metrics: workplace_adoption_rate and average_mask_quality_in_use; maintain needed daily histories for evaluation.
Introduce thin spec-compliant entity wrappers: Household, WorkplaceSchool, PublicPlace, Retailer, MediaChannel, PolicyMaker mapped to existing logic to satisfy interface and naming requirements.
Make CSV output optional via a CLI flag and avoid unconditional writes.
If time allows: add a minimal optional SEIR toggle to compute Rt and infections_averted; otherwise clearly disable with a config flag and document.

task_understanding.adjustments: Adhere strictly to the specified entities, interactions, and parameter names. Treat disease transmission as optional but ensure metrics expectations are clear (either implemented or explicitly disabled via a flag).

data_analysis.adjustments: Normalize incoming parameters to spec names with backward-compatible aliases. Validate presence and ranges; log defaults used. Ensure per-capita inventory initialization scales with population size.

model_planning.adjustments: Design the network rewiring fix first. Plan thin wrapper classes to meet entity specifications without large refactors. Define minimal access-control flow and metrics pipeline. Scope an optional lightweight SEIR with a feature flag.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement adjacency-set rewiring with undirected edges; refactor purchasing to use price elasticity and affordability; add attitude_weight in utility; implement access-control gating and penalties; add new metrics and CLI flag; introduce spec-named entity wrappers.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks/tests: graph symmetry post-rewiring, construction time scales ~O(Nk); parameters alias mapping works; access-control paths executed; metrics present and non-empty; CSV only when flag set; main() callable and CLI robust.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke tests at N=1k and performance test at N=10k to confirm rewiring scalability. Validate adoption dynamics respond to policy, media, and price changes. Test access-control impacts on penalties/denials.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report and verify required metrics: overall adoption, workplace adoption, average_mask_quality_in_use, mandate_compliance_rate; if SEIR enabled, compute Rt and infections_averted; otherwise return explicit placeholders and flag disabled status.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Clearly document spec alignment changes (entity names, parameters), performance fix for rewiring, and any optional features (SEIR flag). Note limitations and next steps if Rt/infections_averted remain disabled.
